data.body:
AC amendment (gap-analysis: implicit_assumption): Pin integration test to canonical ALLOWED list source and assert parity with SKILL.md/template.

Amend ab56 acceptance criteria so the test derives the 7 allowed detected_by values from the canonical source (ALLOWED array in infer-detected-by.sh) rather than a hardcoded list inside the test. The test must additionally assert that BOTH plugins/dso/skills/create-bug/SKILL.md AND plugins/dso/skills/shared/prompts/bug-report-template.md contain all 7 values verbatim. This converts three independent enumeration copies into one enforced contract: any typo or drift in any file fails the test.

Additional verify step: for v in $(grep -oE 'ALLOWED=\([^)]+\)' plugins/dso/scripts/infer-detected-by.sh | tr -d '"()' | sed 's/ALLOWED=//'); do grep -q -- "$v" plugins/dso/skills/create-bug/SKILL.md && grep -q -- "$v" plugins/dso/skills/shared/prompts/bug-report-template.md || { echo "DRIFT: $v missing from SKILL.md or template"; exit 1; }; done
